title: Patterns: data table and filters
goal: A sortable table and its filter bar
acceptance: Data table with keyed rows and sortable headers (aria-sort); filters bound by inputs and outputs
privacy: Neutral, invented test data only; no consuming project's real data, secrets or tokens in Git.
